header: Star Fox 64's regular plan for play_page.mjs, 2-3 minutes with every timeout counted: the launcher, Load ROM once the
page has its shader list (Chrome builds the whole list behind the launcher and says when it is done, and a click
while it builds is lost; Firefox builds none there, and says so as the launcher comes up), the title, the main menu's
Main Game, the Lylat map (Start skips its prologue, A picks Corneria) and Corneria the way a player starts it, a need
that it is playing, then 60 s of Corneria with A held down and the shields kept full (tools/shader_survey.js's
fireFor, patches/shader_survey.c's invincible). The Arwing flies on rails, so nothing here is timed on the game's
clock. tools/play_plan_extended.json goes on to two more levels, for when a longer play is needed.
